commands.command: npm run tauri -- android build --debug --target x86_64
commands.summary: Rebuilt the Android debug APK with the new icon set.
Reinstalled the Android debug app; package updated successfully.
Built a real Windows NSIS installer (release profile) with the new icon set and the Desktop-shortcut NSIS hook: RepoPact Workbench_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe.

Per-user (currentUser) install verified programmatically: installed exe at %LOCALAPPDATA%\RepoPact Workbench\repopact-desktop.exe, HKCU uninstall registry entry present with correct DisplayIcon/InstallLocation/UninstallString, Start-menu .lnk and Desktop .lnk both created, both targeting the installed exe (not a dev or Cargo target path).

Installed-runtime launch smoke test: process started from the installed path, MainWindowTitle='RepoPact Workbench', Responding=True after 8s. Deeper interactive smoke test (repository selection, Dashboard/Work/Validation rendering) requires either Jeremy's own hands or a computer-use grant this non-interactive session could not obtain (request_access was auto-denied with no interactive user present to approve it) -- left for Jeremy's own confirmation per AC-004/AC-006.

Uninstall removed the installed exe, install directory, both shortcuts, and the uninstall registry entry (all confirmed absent). Reinstall restored the exe and both shortcuts, and the reinstalled app launched again (new PID, Responding=True). No user repositories or RepoPact source trees were touched by uninstall.
Rust workspace regression after the tauri.conf.json/icon changes: all tests passed, including the WI057 snapshot_git_invocation_count_is_bounded_independent_of_work_items regression.

android_icon_verification.steps: rebuilt the debug APK, reinstalled over the existing package (no uninstall/cache-clear needed -- adb install -r updated the launcher icon cleanly), returned to the home screen, opened the app drawer via swipe-up, and visually confirmed the launcher tile now shows the teal 'RP' mark (not the prior Tauri placeholder) under the label 'RepoPac...'.
android_icon_verification.tap_to_launch: tapped the new icon in the app drawer; the Workbench's own splash screen (which also renders the RP mark at full size) appeared, followed by the normal repository-selection screen -- confirmed via screenshot.
android_icon_verification.icon_cache: no launcher-cache clear or extra reinstall was required beyond the normal debug APK reinstall.

windows_nsis_verification.install_mode: currentUser (per-user, no administrator privileges required), matching the existing NsisConfig default and the directive's preference.
windows_nsis_verification.desktop_shortcut_mechanism: added via Tauri's supported NsisConfig.installerHooks (rust/apps/repopact-desktop/src-tauri/windows/nsis-hooks.nsh), using the NSIS_HOOK_POSTINSTALL/NSIS_HOOK_PREUNINSTALL macros and Tauri's own $INSTDIR/${MAINBINARYNAME} installer variables -- no hard-coded dev or Cargo target path, no replacement of the generated installer template.
windows_nsis_verification.installed_exe_icon: confirmed via System.Drawing.Icon.ExtractAssociatedIcon on the installed exe: the extracted icon is the new RP mark, so both the Start-menu .lnk (icon index 0, default) and the Desktop .lnk (explicit icon path to the installed exe, index 0) show it.
reinstall_confirmed: application launches again from the Start-menu shortcut
